Classification Items (6 - 10)

Directions: In questions 6 - 10 a set of four words is given. Three of the words are related in some ways. The remaining word is not related to the tst choose the word that does not fit the relation youlu choice on the separate answer sheet provided.

6)
explanation:
Leopard, Tiger, and Lion are wild cats belonging to the same animal family (Felidae).

 Elephant does not belong to this group, so it does not fit the relation.
Pen, pencil, and eraser are writing or drawing tools. A book is not a writing instrument, so it does not fit the group.

Order, chaos, and confusion are related to states of organization or disorder.

 'Legal' relates to law and does not fit with the others.

Eye, Ear and Tongue are sense organs.

 Heart is an internal organ and not a sense organ, so it does not fit the group.

Publisher, reporter, and writer are directly involved in producing or distributing written content. 

A reader consumes the content but does not produce or distribute it, so it does not fit the group
